title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: MSP A5 MERGED. PR #31 landed as 42e7d49 on origin/main, both required checks green, verified after the merge. A5's test and coverage receipt are present on main. M5 is now UNBLOCKED on both preconditions - A5 landed, and 0188 discharged the restore-path residual - and is the next and last gating milestone before the tail of the spec. Nothing is running. Local checkout is parked on the merged branch test/a5-merge-poll-characterization with the five pre-existing dirty paths.
spine.next_step: DISPATCH A DEDICATED SMALL DYNAMIC WORKFLOW TO FULLY IMPLEMENT AND SHIP M5 - explicit user directive at close. The COMPLETE dispatch brief is in this thread's LATEST SESSION LOG; lift it almost verbatim. Preflight in the MAIN thread: re-derive origin/main (42e7d49) and confirm green, read 0185/0187/0188/0189/0190, re-confirm the anchors, then cut the branch (suggested feat/m5-quiescent-exit). Distinct scratch subdir per agent. M5 TOUCHES POLICED TWINS - add a fourth verify lens for twin parity.
open_risks: M5 IS THE FIRST MSP HERE TOUCHING POLICED TWINS. leases.mjs is a WHOLE mirror; progressPossible, maxSteps, the poll-cycle guard and the tick loop all live in it, so the exit likely lands in BOTH copies. Twin edits land in both files in ONE commit. Check reconcile.mjs too.

M5 SHIPS SIX THINGS, NOT THE TWO THE LANDING TABLE LISTS: the quiescent exit, the continuation block with identity (from M6), deletion of the bounded poll, of progressPossible and of maxSteps (0185), and the section-11 per-exit latency emitter.
Omitting M5's section-11 latency emitter leaves the design's central claim - that residual latency is its only cost - unfalsifiable. Section 11 requires it MEASURED, not assumed.

THE M4 TRAP M5 could repeat: never rewrite a characterization test's assertions in the same commit as the behavior change. DELETING merge-poll-characterization.test.mjs alongside the mechanism it pins is correct (0189, 0190); rewriting it launders the evidence.

TERMINATION MUST BE PROVEN, NOT ASSERTED. Once maxSteps is deleted, the spec's claim that every iteration either acts or exits becomes load-bearing for liveness. M5 owes a test that the loop terminates on the no-actions path; a hang is worse than the bounded stop it replaces (0185).

Give each workflow agent a DISTINCT scratch subdirectory. A5's inertness verifier had its own scratch file overwritten mid-run by a sibling sharing the path; its results survived only because they were printed first.

COMMIT docs/invariants/coverage/<branch>.json with all 12 registry ids, verdict domain two-valued. The PR-mode gate diffs merge-base..HEAD and cannot see untracked paths; it never checks whether a check string is TRUE (0143). Proven dischargeable by PR #31.

From 0187, assigned to M5: advance.toRestack is computed (reconcile.mjs:122/:130 + twin) and logged (mitosis.js:3996) with ZERO consumers. The same string carries the AIMD clause M4 deletes; prompt-snapshot.test.mjs may pin it, unverified.

From 0188, assigned to M5: the isBuiltResume restore call at mitosis.js:4586 passes only builtRef, so the sha-verification block at :4572-4579 never runs there, while :4592 passes requireSha true. Decide explicitly whether M5 closes it or declares it again.

From 0190, assigned to M5: mergeWatchPrompt defaults to 300/30 internally at mitosis.js:2817-2818, so the :5068 call site is unpinned. If M5 deletes that call site the residual dies with it - say so rather than leaving it dangling.
supersedeOpenPr (mitosis.js:4386-4421) is DEAD CODE with zero call sites tree-wide (0188). Not a live ship path; do not chase it again.
M4 stays THREATENED by 174a0dc: three behavior changes plus the structural publishedSpecPath share one commit range and three characterization tests were rewritten in it.
computeLogicalRunId still hashes only spec path + baseBranch (0176). Identity is three-valued and the published spec path is relative (0178) - M5 consumes this for the continuation block.
published.sourcePrefix is logged on disagreement but does not WIN (0179). A relaunch under a different prefix can re-ship shipped work.
PR scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied, later facts go in a comment (0142). pr-create rejects angle brackets in a --what value - reword, never force. Merge stays human-gated.

NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. Use the AsyncFunction harness with a stub agent; MITOSIS_PATH swaps in a mutated scratch copy. Run A5's test against a scratch PRE-deletion copy to prove M5's deletion is real before deleting the test.

A red result from a hand-rolled shell one-liner is suspect BEFORE the code is - re-run it in node. A5's implementer hit exactly this with a PIPESTATUS artifact and re-derived rather than reporting the suspect result.

Five pre-existing dirty paths persist (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, two .bak files, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A. 17 worktree entries remain live; no reaper verb.
Spec/plan anchors remain stale wholesale (0148 rejected a standalone rewrite). Section 10's M3 row and section 8 row 2 are inaccurate (0185) - re-baseline them BY EXECUTION inside M5.

Standing method rule, EIGHT instances deep (0159, 0163, 0181, 0184, 0188, 0189, 0190): verify a confident finding against the mechanism before acting. Every A5 scope change came from mutation; reading for absence would have missed two real holes.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
